description: Add one company to one of the person's StockLens portfolios as a company they follow, so its score stays readable here. Call it only when the person has asked for it or agreed to an offer. Without portfolio_id or portfolio_name it adds to the default portfolio, and the result names the portfolio that received it. Relay the result's message, which says where the company went. A status other than added is an answer, not an error: relay its message and act on next_step. After an add the person accepted from a get_market_summary offer, call get_market_summary again to answer their question. One ticker per call; for a list of companies, use add_to_watchlist_batch. It does not trade, record a holding or move money.

exchange.description: Exchange code (e.g. NASDAQ). Optional. Resolved automatically if omitted.

portfolio_id.description: The id of the portfolio to add to, as get_portfolio_insights lists it. Optional: without it or portfolio_name the company goes to the default portfolio.

portfolio_name.description: The name of the portfolio to add to, as the person names it (exact, case does not matter). Optional.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g. AAPL). Exactly one ticker per call.

name: add_to_watchlist
title: Add to Portfolio
